title: Charge the same capacitor
hook: Change voltage magnitude and predict stored charge magnitude.
misconception: stored charge magnitude stays fixed when voltage magnitude doubles.
objective: Apply Q = C·abs(V) to compare stored charge magnitude when voltage magnitude changes, under the stated assumptions.

claims.text: With an ideal capacitor with fixed capacitance, Q = C·abs(V). When voltage magnitude doubles, stored charge magnitude becomes 2 times its original value.
claims.source: Idealized model Q = C·abs(V); scaling exponent 1. Physics and assumptions await independent review.

recall.question: Consider an ideal capacitor with fixed capacitance, with a nonzero initial result. If voltage magnitude triples from a positive value, what is the multiplier on stored charge magnitude?
recall.why: Apply Q = C·abs(V) under the same assumptions: the multiplier is 3.
